prompt:
Subject:
Blue sky and white knit pattern

Main Body:
A vertical chest-up close-up of a single woman in the center of the screen, captured from a low angle against a vivid blue sky. The white open-knit halter top and short hair blowing in the wind are the main features.

Character/Expression:
Face is front-facing, amber eyes directed straight at the camera, and a peaceful expression with glossy coral lips lightly closed. Slightly long oval face with a small rounded chin, almond-shaped eyes with constrained width, naturally thick loose eyebrows, a thin nose bridge, and a rounded nose tip; the upper lip is thin while the lower lip is thick. Bright glossy skin with subtle blush and thin eyeliner. Dark brown chin-length bob with a left-side part, flowing significantly to the left of the screen due to the wind, with thin strands of hair crossing the forehead and cheeks.

Clothing/Pose:
White knit halter neck cropped top. The neck and hem have thick ribbing, the bodice has a vertical open-knit pattern, the center of the chest is deeply open, and it features white laces crossed and tied. Both shoulders and arms are lowered naturally, with the upper body facing forward.

Background/Light:
The entire background is a deep, vivid blue sky with no clouds or buildings. Hard direct sunlight from the upper left illuminates the left side of the face, nose bridge, collarbone, shoulders, and the white knit pattern strongly, creating shallow shadows on the opposite side.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio, a close-up portrait capturing everything from the top of the head to below the chest from a low angle perspective lower than the chest. The face is in the center of the upper half, shoulders and arms are at the left and right edges, and the top is cropped at the bottom edge. Focus on the face and the lacing, showing the blue sky uniformly.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photo in harsh summer light. High-definition rendering of subtle skin gloss, hair strands blowing in the wind, and the open-knit cotton and laces, strongly contrasting blue and white.

Negative:
Do not close the central lacing; do not change the wind direction or the short bob.
